integrity: The known optimum 6 and the ordinary constant-GC optimum 12 are treated as prior work. The new claim is the complete equality census, viable-parent decomposition, and explicit symmetry-orbit classification. Two compatibility formulations, two exact clique searches, and the parent-transversal reconstruction are checked independently.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification only for DNA length 4, GC-content 2, Hamming distance at least 3, and reverse-complement distance at least 3. No claim is made for longer strands, other GC contents, other distance thresholds, or additional biochemical constraints.
title: Complete equality census for the smallest optimal constant-GC reverse-complement DNA code
